title: Artists in the Royal Tree
content: The British Royal Family has for centuries included some devoted and accomplished artists.A view of Windsor Town and Castle by Prince Ernest Augustus, 1780,Daily MailRoyals have always had the benefit of travel and of excellent instruction, and the blessing — or the curse — of being free from commercial considerations.Prince Charles is a devoted watercolor painter, but he's also the most articulate advocate of amateur painting since Winston Churchill. (Link to video) He hosts this BBC documentary charting the artistic apples on his family tree.-----Daily Mail:Long to frame over us: From Victoria's sketchbook and Elizabeth II's circus horse to a 'Leonardo', 350 years of a very artistic Royal FamilyThanks,Patrick.JamesGurney Art onInstagramGurneyJourney YouTube channelMy Public FacebookpageGurneyJourney onPinterest@GurneyJourney on Twitter
